js: 'A reply in flight survives leaving the Chat: send, leave for Settings while the model still reads its prompt, come back, and the thread shows the turn as in flight (its bubble streaming, Stop), then its tokens live; leave and come back again mid-stream, and the end lands in the same bubble, stored; then a Continue of it, left and come back to while the model reads its prompt, shows the reply once. Needs the mock with a slow prefill (ECHO=1 PREFILL_DELAY=5 STREAM_DELAY=0.5 scripts/mock-openai.py PORT) and the fake-echo alias (scripts/chat-actions-setup.sh); scripts/chat-drives.sh starts both. Writes one thread and its two messages.'

(() => { localStorage.removeItem('lmgw.streamReturn.tid'); fetch('/chat/api/threads', {method: 'POST', headers: {'content-type': 'application/json'}, body: JSON.stringify({model_alias: 'fake-echo', kind: 'chat'})}).then(r => r.json()).then(t => localStorage.setItem('lmgw.streamReturn.tid', String(t.id))); return 'creating a thread'; })()

(() => { const ta = document.querySelector('.composer-input'); ta.value = 'one two three four five six seven eight nine ten'; ta.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', {bubbles: true})); return 'typed'; })()
(() => { [...document.querySelectorAll('a[href="/settings"]')].find(a => a.checkVisibility()).click(); return 'to Settings, in the app (a go step would wait for the stream to end)'; })()
(() => { history.pushState(null, '', '/chat?t=' + localStorage.getItem('lmgw.streamReturn.tid')); dispatchEvent(new PopStateEvent('popstate')); return 'back to the thread'; })()

until: (() => { const l = (() => { const a = [...document.querySelectorAll('.chat-col .msg-assistant')]; return a[a.length - 1] || null; })(); return !!l && !!l.querySelector('.caret') && !!document.querySelector('.composer-send[aria-label="Stop"]'); })()
label: back while the model reads its prompt: the reply shows as in flight (its bubble streaming, Stop)

expect: (() => { const l = (() => { const a = [...document.querySelectorAll('.chat-col .msg-assistant')]; return a[a.length - 1] || null; })(); return document.querySelectorAll('.chat-col .msg-assistant').length === 1 && l.querySelector('.md').textContent.trim() === '' && document.querySelectorAll('.chat-col .msg-item-user').length === 1; })()
label: one question and one reply bubble, the reply with no words yet

until: (() => { const l = (() => { const a = [...document.querySelectorAll('.chat-col .msg-assistant')]; return a[a.length - 1] || null; })(); return !!l && !!l.querySelector('.caret') && l.querySelector('.md').textContent.includes('Echo: one'); })()
label: its tokens stream in live

js: (() => { [...document.querySelectorAll('a[href="/settings"]')].find(a => a.checkVisibility()).click(); return 'to Settings, in the app (a go step would wait for the stream to end)'; })()
(() => { history.pushState(null, '', '/chat?t=' + localStorage.getItem('lmgw.streamReturn.tid')); dispatchEvent(new PopStateEvent('popstate')); return 'back to the thread'; })()

until: (() => { const l = (() => { const a = [...document.querySelectorAll('.chat-col .msg-assistant')]; return a[a.length - 1] || null; })(); return !!l && !!l.querySelector('.caret') && l.querySelector('.md').textContent.includes('Echo: one') && document.querySelectorAll('.chat-col .msg-assistant').length === 1; })()
label: left and back again mid-stream: still streaming, the words so far kept

until: (() => { const l = (() => { const a = [...document.querySelectorAll('.chat-col .msg-assistant')]; return a[a.length - 1] || null; })(); return !!l && !l.querySelector('.caret') && !!l.dataset.mid && l.querySelector('.md').textContent.trim() === 'Echo: one two three four five six seven eight nine ten' && !!document.querySelector('.composer-send[aria-label="Send"]'); })()
label: the end lands in the same bubble, stored (its id), and Send is back

expect: (async () => { const d = await (await fetch('/chat/api/threads/' + localStorage.getItem('lmgw.streamReturn.tid'))).json(); const a = d.messages.filter(m => m.role === 'assistant'); return a.length === 1 && a[0].content === 'Echo: one two three four five six seven eight nine ten'; })()
label: the stored reply is the whole one

js: 'A Continue of the stored reply, left and come back to while the model reads its prompt: the reply is one bubble, streaming, never the stored reply and its live bubble side by side.'
(() => { history.pushState(null, '', '/chat?t=' + localStorage.getItem('lmgw.streamReturn.tid')); dispatchEvent(new PopStateEvent('popstate')); return 'back to the thread'; })()

until: (() => { const l = (() => { const a = [...document.querySelectorAll('.chat-col .msg-assistant')]; return a[a.length - 1] || null; })(); return !!l && !!l.querySelector('.caret') && !!document.querySelector('.composer-send[aria-label="Stop"]'); })()
label: back mid-Continue: the reply shows as in flight

expect: (() => { const a = document.querySelectorAll('.chat-col .msg-assistant'); return a.length === 1 && document.querySelectorAll('.chat-col [data-mid="' + a[0].dataset.mid + '"]').length === 1 && a[0].querySelector('.md').textContent.trim() === 'Echo: one two three four five six seven eight nine ten'; })()
label: the continued reply once (one bubble, its id once), its text so far kept

until: (() => { const l = (() => { const a = [...document.querySelectorAll('.chat-col .msg-assistant')]; return a[a.length - 1] || null; })(); return !!l && !l.querySelector('.caret') && l.querySelector('.md').textContent.trim() === 'Echo: one two three four five six seven eight nine ten…and then some more words.' && !!document.querySelector('.composer-send[aria-label="Send"]'); })()
label: the continuation lands in the same bubble
no bubble twice after the Continue

expect: (async () => { const d = await (await fetch('/chat/api/threads/' + localStorage.getItem('lmgw.streamReturn.tid'))).json(); const a = d.messages.filter(m => m.role === 'assistant'); return a.length === 1 && a[0].content === 'Echo: one two three four five six seven eight nine ten…and then some more words.'; })()
label: the stored reply is the continued one
